News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER www / West Philippine Sea West Philippine Sea AFP confirms sighting of Chinese bomber plane over WPS By: Zacarian Gavin Sarao - @inquirerdotnet INQUIRER.net / 11:16 PM November 25, 2026 Share: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) on Wednesday confirmed the sighting of a Chinese bomber plane over the West Philippine Sea, saying it flew as close as 45 nautical miles from the country’s shoreline.
This was according to AFP spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad who revealed that the AFP tracked a Chinese H-6 strategic bomber over the West Philippine Sea around Nov. 21.
“That bomber was 170 nautical miles from Metro Manila, the closest it got to our shoreline was 45 nautical miles,” said Trinidad during a Kapihan sa Manila Prince Hotel forum.

According to the AFP official, the move can be seen as China’s military “flexing its muscles,” particularly due to its close distance to the country.
“It only shows that the PLA (People’s Liberation Army) per se, the Air Force, Army, Navy, the entire PLA, is now flexing its muscles,” said Tridad.

“Dati-rati ang mga patrols niya were closer to the mainland of China. Today, mas umaabot sa atin,” he added.
(Previously, their patrols were closer to the Chinese mainland. Today, they are getting closer to us.)
However, Trinidad dissuaded rumors that the relatively close proximity of the bomber plane was an indication of a missile practice, tagging such reports as mere “media-stir.”
“It was a normal patrol conducted by the H-6 bomber. It has been conducted in the past over flights by bombers of the PLA Air Force over Scarborough Shoal, Bajo de Masinloc,” he clarified.
“This time we were able to monitor it and there is no indicator that there was such a rehearsal for a missile strike,” he added.
